basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old graphic designer living in Baltimore, Maryland. I've recently discovered the joys of Reddit and love exploring various communities during my evening downtime. I'm particularly interested in humor and education, often spending time on subreddits related to my hobbies and professional interests. I'm currently single and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals online. My typical online hours are between 7 PM and midnight, as I juggle my work commitments during the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts and graphic design, with a bachelor's degree from the Maryland Institute College of Art. My interest in health topics like B12 deficiency stems from personal research and self-teaching, driven by a desire to improve my own well-being.
